strategy: UGB Emerge Eldrazi - Go-Wide Token Swarm
identity: Six colorless Emerge Eldrazi finishers fueled by undying/self-returning fodder and token generators, with Blood Artist and Morbid Opportunist monetizing the resulting sacrifice loop.
